messages:
incident-bot: Pager Alert — metering.token_drift triggered (sev=2). metric=token_count_drift pct=9.2 timeframe=5m
maya: ack. I'm oncall. Pulling console + latest emit logs.
maya: @jamal can you join — looks like EU emitter cluster.
jamal: joining. grabbing logs from emitter-proxy-eu1. I see retry bursts starting 2023-12-04T02:12:03Z.
jamal: suspected duplicate events from retry loop; IDs repeated. patch in proxy to stop retries rolling out now.
opsbot: deploy: stop-retry-loop v2 -> emitter-proxy-eu1 succeeded (rollout id abc123)
maya: nice. sophee, can you check billing flags/CS impact?
sophee: checking billing dashboard — ~42 overage flags since 02:10 UTC, mostly starter-tier customers. sample: tenant_acct_42.
liam: quick query:
```sql
SELECT tenant_id, count(*) as flags, sum(tokens) as tokens
FROM billing.flags
WHERE created_at >= '2023-12-04T02:00:00Z'
GROUP BY tenant_id
ORDER BY flags DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
liam: result estimate: ~120k extra tokens counted, likely noise from duplicates; projected delta ~$40k if billed.
jamal: starting dedupe/replay job (replay-dedupe-job-1749). ETA 45m. will produce reconciliation report.
maya: mitigation: stop retries (done), throttle emitter to 0.5 qps for EU region while we reconcile.
opsbot: config change: emitter-throttle eu-region set to 0.5 qps — applied.
sophee: CS: drafting message for impacted customers, propose 1:1 credits where we detect duplicate-based overages. tagging @cs-team to verify language.
cs-notify-bot: ticket created: CS-174999 - Billing flags investigation for EU emitter duplicates.
jamal: reconcile job kicked; first pass dedupe shows ~85% of flagged tokens are duplicates.
liam: impact summary: customers with >1% overage will be auto-credited. Estimated refund pool ~$30k.
maya: good. Ops: monitor for 20m, then hand off to billing-reconcile team for next 6 hours.
jamal: logging note: root cause likely upstream retry policy not honoring idempotency header under transient 502s. I'll open PR to add stricter idempotency enforcement.
maya: created incident doc: https://wiki.redwood.ai/incidents/1749998887
maya: status -> mitigated. oncall -> handing off to billing-recon (jamal, sophee). last update in 45m or earlier if new alerts.
liam: adding tags: billing, metering, duplicate-emitter, eu-region.
opsbot: incident-bot: closing pager (reason: mitigation applied, reconciliation in progress).
maya: thanks all. followup: RCA and billing reconciliation ticket due EOD.
